summary: Injured male hiker at Zapata Falls who had fallen and was bleeding from the face. AVSAR was called out; before team deployment the subject reached the campground with an injured ankle and shoulder plus facial cuts and was transferred to the hospital by EMS; AVSAR stood down.
notes: Reporting party left the falls to get cell service; AVSAR unable to re-contact him.
